name: moon
description: Moon 开发工作台：多智能体房间协作与任务看板

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "cargo run --manifest-path server-rs/Cargo.toml" "npm run dev -w @moon/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @moon/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @moon/web
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @moon/web && npm run dev -w @moon/desktop
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @moon/web && npm run build -w @moon/desktop
